excogitate.definition:
v come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
v reflect deeply on a subject
excogitate.translation: vt. 想出, 研究出, 设计, 发明

excogitated.translation: v. 想出( excogitate的过去式和过去分词 ); 设计出; 图谋; 算计

excogitates.definition:
v come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
v reflect deeply on a subject
excogitates.translation: v. 想出( excogitate的第三人称单数 ); 设计出; 图谋; 算计

excogitating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Excogitate
excogitating.translation: v. 想出( excogitate的现在分词 ); 设计出; 图谋; 算计

excogitation.definition: n. thinking something out with care in order to achieve complete understanding of it
excogitation.translation: n. 想出, 方案, 计策, 计划, 设法, 设计

excogitative.definition: s. concerned with excogitating or having the power of excogitation
excogitative.translation: a. 想出的, 发明的, 计划的

excom.translation: abbr. Executive Committee 执行委员会; Exlan computer color matching 依克斯兰电子配色系统（日本商名）

excommunicable.definition:
a. Liable or deserving to be excommunicated; making
   excommunication possible or proper.
excommunicable.translation: a. 可革出教会的, 应革出教会的

excommunicant.definition: n. One who has been excommunicated.

excommunicate.definition:
v. exclude from a church or a religious community
v. oust or exclude from a group or membership by decree
excommunicate.translation:
vt. 开除...教籍, 逐出教会
a. 被逐出教会的
n. 被逐出教会的人

excommunicated.definition:
v exclude from a church or a religious community
v oust or exclude from a group or membership by decree
excommunicated.translation: v. 开除…的教籍, 把…逐出教会( excommunicate的过去式和过去分词 )

excommunicates.definition:
v exclude from a church or a religious community
v oust or exclude from a group or membership by decree
excommunicates.translation:
n. 开除…的教籍, 把…逐出教会( excommunicate的名词复数 )
v. 开除…的教籍, 把…逐出教会( excommunicate的第三人称单数 )

excommunicating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Excommunicate
excommunicating.translation: v. 开除…的教籍, 把…逐出教会( excommunicate的现在分词 )

excommunication.definition:
n. the state of being excommunicated
n. the act of banishing a member of a church from the communion of believers and the privileges of the church; cutting a person off from a religious society
excommunication.translation:
n. 开除教籍, 逐出教会
[法] 开除, 逐出教会

excommunications.definition:
n. the state of being excommunicated
n. the act of banishing a member of a church from the communion of believers and the privileges of the church; cutting a person off from a religious society

excommunicator.translation: n. 逐出教会者, 被开除者

excommunicatory.translation: a. 开除的, 逐出教会的

excon.translation: abbr. executive control 执行控制

excoriable.translation: a. 应受谴责的, 可非难的

excoriate.definition:
v express strong disapproval of
v tear or wear off the skin or make sore by abrading
excoriate.translation: vt. 剥皮, 擦破皮肤, 严厉的责难

excoriated.translation: v. 擦伤( excoriate的过去式和过去分词 ); 擦破（皮肤）; 剥（皮）; 严厉指责

excoriates.definition:
v express strong disapproval of
v tear or wear off the skin or make sore by abrading
excoriates.translation: v. 擦伤( excoriate的第三人称单数 ); 擦破（皮肤）; 剥（皮）; 严厉指责

excoriating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Eccoriate
excoriating.translation: v. 擦伤( excoriate的现在分词 ); 擦破（皮肤）; 剥（皮）; 严厉指责

excoriation.translation:
n. 表皮脱落, 严厉责难, 苛责
[医] 表皮脱落

excoriations.definition:
plural of excoriation
n. severe censure
excoriations.translation:
(excoriation 的复数) n. 表皮脱落, 严厉责难, 苛责
[医] 表皮脱落

excorticate.definition: v. t. To strip of bark or skin; to decorticate.

excortication.definition:
n. The act of stripping off bark, or the state of being
   thus stripped; decortication.
